The '''1988–89 Serie A''' was won by [[Inter Milan|Inter]], who won the title comfortably by an 11-point margin over runners-up [[S.S.C. Napoli|Napoli]]. [[A.C. Milan|Milan]]'s triumph in the [[UEFA Champions League|European Cup]] meant Italy would be entering two teams – both the two Milan sides – into the European Cup for the 1989–90 season. [[Torino F.C.|Torino]], [[Pescara Calcio|Pescara]], [[Pisa Calcio|Pisa]] and [[Como]] were relegated to Serie B.

==Teams==
[[Bologna FC|Bologna]], [[US Lecce|Lecce]], [[SS Lazio|Lazio]] and [[Atalanta BC|Atalanta]] had been promoted from [[Serie B]].

==Events==
Following the expansion of the league, a fourth relegation was added.
